en.sayed-athar-husain-rizvi-&-sayed-maqs: 4. And from the previous chain from Abdillah b. Muskan from Dawud b. Farqad from Abi Shaybah al-Zuhri from Abi Ja’far (a.s.) who said: “
A person who talks bad about each and every small thing is a sinner. He faces people with a face and has another on their back.”
